svg.aria-label: linkify. A private Android app for saving links from any app. The library stays on your phone, with optional sync through your own Google Drive. Year: 2026. Type: Android app. Role: Solo project. Built with React Native, Expo, TypeScript, SQLite, NativeWind, Kotlin, Google Drive API.
